description: This file defines the CartService class, which provides business logic for cart operations such as retrieving, creating, updating, and removing items from a shopping cart within an e-commerce application.

classes.name: CartService
classes.description: Application service class for managing shopping cart operations.

methods.name: getOrCreateActiveCart
methods.description: Retrieves an existing active cart for the given store and customer or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Fetches a cart by its unique identifier, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart.

methods.name: setItemQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity for a specific product in the cart; removes it if quantity is zero.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart.
